summary: Frontend-only regression check after the key-prop refactor (SocialMedia, Landingpage, Guardian, Copywriter, ContentCalendar, Campaign, BrandDesigner) and Python is->== test-file cleanup. All 7 requested pages render correctly and end-to-end LLM flows still work. ZERO React key warnings and ZERO console errors observed across every tested page. No regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: Key-prop refactor verified visually in source: SocialMedia uses key=`${p.platform}-${i}` for posts and `${h}-${j}` for hashtags; Landingpage uses key=`benefit-${b.title||i}`, `tm-${tm.name||i}`, `faq-${f.q||i}`, `feat-${i}-${f.slice(0,16)}`, `kw-${i}-${k}`; Guardian uses `check-${i}-${c.label||''}`, `imp-...`, `str-...`, `star-${i}`; Copywriter uses `var-${i}-${String(v).slice(0,16)}`; ContentCalendar uses `${it.day}-${it.platform}-${i}` and `${h}-${j}`; Campaign uses `${p.platform}-${i}` and `${h}-${j}`; BrandDesigner uses `${b.id}-color-${i}`. All keys are stable enough for the current use cases.

Minor: BrandDesigner color swatch key still embeds the loop index (`${b.id}-color-${i}`) but since the underlying array (primary/secondary/accent) is fixed-length and order-stable, this is acceptable.

Minor: ContentCalendar's hashtag key `${h}-${j}` could still collide if the same hashtag string appears multiple times within the same card's truncated 4-item slice; risk is theoretical only and not observed in 15 generated cards.
seed_data_creation: No persistent data created. LLM generations for Copywriter/Social/Guardian/Landingpage/Calendar were triggered for rendering verification only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 dashboard module cards present. DE/EN toggle buttons in top-right (DE active by default). Pages tested live against https://kc-marketing-hub.preview.emergentagent.com: /, /copy (title+body+2 variants OK), /social (Instagram+TikTok posts with hashtags OK), /guardian (score 78/100, 5 brand checks, stars, improvements, strengths OK), /landing (benefits, 3 testimonials, FAQ, pricing features, SEO keywords, HTML export button works OK), /brand (1 KickstarterCash.club card with 3 color swatches OK), /calendar (15 day-cards x 3 platforms with 60 hashtag spans OK). No console errors, no pageerrors, no React key/duplicate warnings on any page.
rca of the issue: N/A - regression check only, all green.
